Instantly vs Smartlead for inbox warmups?
I’ve used a few tools in my time for outbound email. Curious what you all are using today and what might make one better than the other? For context I came from B2B F500 company with a whole demand gen team including CRM manager, email copywriter, etc. This is for my own self-funded company with one employee at the moment (me!). 

Thanks in advance. Also open to other methods or tools anybody has found useful heading in to 2027 and best/modern practices.
